title: Luxury Duplex Penthouse for sale in Marina de Puente Romano, Marbella
summary:
This is an enchanting duplex penthouse nestled on the frontline of Puente Romano’s beach, offering a privileged location within the gated community.  This remarkable property showcases breathtaking sea views, impeccable interior design by Ambience and an irresistible atmosphere. The main floor features a spacious living room adorned with floor-to- ceiling glass sliding doors that flood the space with natural light. Meticulously decorated with tasteful furnishings and finishes, the use of neutral tones complemented by vibrant splashes of colour creates a soothing and inviting atmosphere. A double-sided fireplace separates from the living space the exquisite open-plan kitchen and dining areas. From this level, direct terrace access leads to a covered dining and chill-out area boasting uninterrupted sea views. Each bedroom is a luxurious en-suite sanctuary, meticulously designed to elevate comfort and

opulence. The elegant master bedroom offers ample space and a stunning bathroom, while its private terrace with a pool and chill-out area overlooks the sea, providing a unique and exclusive retreat. With its southern orientation, this splendid penthouse embodies a seaside paradise, perfectly positioned along Marbella’s prestigious Golden Mile.
